title: Bug when remapping keys º to ~, + to ´, ~ to º and ´ to +

status.label: Confirm the cyclic dead-key remap on current stable
status.detail: The report lists PowerToys 0.61.1 and says a four-key Portuguese-layout remap eventually emits duplicate acute and tilde characters; current-version behavior is unknown.

judgment.rationale: The author provides a specific four-key mapping on a Brazilian Portuguese system using keys from the Portuguese (Portugal) layout. After a clean boot, two mapped accent/dead-key inputs reportedly begin producing an extra character, including when Shift is held. A commenter suggested that cyclic swaps may be a general problem, but no reproduction or fix is documented. Because the report is from PowerToys 0.61.1, a current-stable retest is needed before proposing a code-level change.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.61.1 and says it runs as administrator.
The system's main language is Portuguese (Brazil), while the remapped keys are from a Portuguese (Portugal) layout.
The four mappings are physical + to acute accent, º to tilde, acute accent to +, and tilde to º.
The author reports that after some time from a clean boot, the acute and tilde inputs produce double-character output, including with Shift held.
The sole comment says cyclic key swaps may be a generic problem; it does not provide reproduction evidence or a fix.
The issue remains open with no assignees.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the exact four mappings still produce duplicate characters on current stable with the same Portuguese layout pairing.

fix_assessment.rationale: The only reproduction report is from PowerToys 0.61.1, and the current behavior of the cyclic remap with Portuguese dead keys is unconfirmed. No active defect is established yet.

issue_context.summary: A four-key cyclic remap using Portuguese layout characters reportedly begins emitting duplicate acute and tilde characters after a clean boot.
known_information: The report lists PowerToys 0.61.1 and says it runs as administrator.
The main system language is Portuguese (Brazil); the mapped keys are from the Portuguese (Portugal) layout.
The four mappings exchange +, º, acute accent, and tilde.
After some time, acute and tilde inputs reportedly produce duplicate characters, including with Shift pressed.
The only comment suggests a general cyclic-remapping issue but does not confirm the same failure or establish a fix.
inferences: The behavior may involve cyclic remap processing or the keyboard layout's dead-key composition, but neither mechanism is confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The described mapping and duplicate output are actionable evidence, but the issue is several years old and the affected characters may be layout-dependent dead keys. Obtain a current-version result before proposing a fix or treating the old behavior as active.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body and its only comment; the issue has no assignees or linked fix.
Checked the comment's cyclic-swap hypothesis; it is an observation only and does not identify a confirmed shared issue.

information_gaps.why_needed: The report lists PowerToys 0.61.1, and a current retest is needed to establish that the layout-specific failure still exists.
